name: Provost Rhythm Variation
blueprintProse:
Provost Rhythm Variation deliberately modulates sentence lengths to create internal musicality, avoiding uniform cadences. It alternates between punchy fragments, medium declarations, and flowing compound sentences, moving between 3-word and 25-word sentences. 
This technique relies on auditory cortex entrainment and habituation disruption. Readers subconsciously vocalize text during silent reading. Uniform sentence lengths produce a monotonous cadence that dulls reader attention, while varied lengths re-engage cognitive processing and sustain focus.
template: [Short declarative sentence. 3–5 words]. [Fragment or punchy declaration. 2–3 words]. [Medium-length sentence introducing operational context and specific mechanical details. 12–15 words]. [Long, sweeping, descriptive sentence depicting the full systemic transformation, painting a rich mental image of organizational equilibrium and effortless performance. 22–28 words]. [Short concluding hammer. 4–6 words].

example.bland: Modern continuous deployment pipelines require resilient cloud servers to ensure maximum stability. Our platform continuously checks your system configuration across clusters to prevent unexpected service outages. You can install our software using a simple script to protect your environment.
example.optimized: This software is fast. Dead fast. When production traffic spikes unexpectedly on a Friday afternoon, your cluster automatically absorbs the load without dropping a single websocket connection. Nothing crashes. Your on-call engineers sleep peacefully through the night.
